question: Who was the first Indian to win two IPL final Player of the Match awards in 2017and 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krunal Pandya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Krunal Pandya** achieved the distinction of being the first **Indian** cricketer to win two **Player of the Match** awards in the **Indian Premier League (IPL)** finals, specifically in **2017** and **2025**.
 
• In the **2017 IPL Final**, playing for **Mumbai Indians** against **Rising Pune Supergiant**, he scored a crucial **47 runs** off **38 balls**. This performance was instrumental in helping his team secure a narrow **1-run victory** to lift the trophy. ***Hence, the mention of his first award in 2017 is correct.***
 
• As per the records provided, his second **Player of the Match** award in an **IPL final** came in the year **2025**, solidifying his reputation as a "big-match" player who excels under pressure. ***Hence, the mention of his second award in 2025 is correct.***
 
• While several legendary **Indian** players have participated in multiple finals, **Krunal Pandya** is the first to be recognized as the most impactful player on the field in two separate championship-deciding matches.
